args:
repo_root=$(pwd)
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$tmpdir/repo/proj-a" "$tmpdir/repo/group/proj-b"
cat > "$tmpdir/repo/proj-a/airstack.toml" <<'TOML'
[project]
name = "proj-a"
deploy_mode = "remote"
TOML
cat > "$tmpdir/repo/group/proj-b/airstack.toml" <<'TOML'
[project]
name = "proj-b"
deploy_mode = "remote"
TOML
cd "$tmpdir"
AIRSTACK_REPO="$tmpdir/repo" cargo run --manifest-path "$repo_root/Cargo.toml" -p airstack-core -- --json status > "$tmpdir/status.json"
grep -q '"discovered_projects": 2' "$tmpdir/status.json"
grep -q '"project": "proj-a"' "$tmpdir/status.json"
grep -q '"project": "proj-b"' "$tmpdir/status.json"
grep -q '"config_path":' "$tmpdir/status.json"

steps.msg: status autodiscovery aggregates project statuses outside a stack directory
